quotes.text: Building an app for everything isn't really helping. At some point, it's creating a lot of noise.
I promise you, they don't build airplanes, they don't build cars without modeling every single part of that vehicle.
The grass is not greener on the other side. Don't get me wrong, the pixie dust was certainly a big draw, it certainly got me excited to go work there.
